name: Hilton Tokyo
accessSummary: Nishi-Shinjuku Station (Marunouchi Line) Exit C8: about 2 min walk / Tochomae Station Exit A7: about 3 min walk / Shinjuku Station West Exit: about 10 min walk

rooms.name: 3F Miyabi The Suite
rooms.note: The banquet room page lists 12 for a seated dinner, while the floor map PDF leaves the seated dinner column blank and shows boardroom 7/6.

ops.parking: The hotel has a car park with 280 spaces on basement levels 2 and 3 (height limit 2.1 m). For banquet and meeting use, parking is free for up to 3 hours 30 minutes, with a maximum of 2,700 yen within 24 hours. Extension is 300 yen per 30 minutes.
ops.restaurants: The hotel has Metropolitan Grill (grill cuisine), Japanese cuisine "Junisoh", Chinese cuisine "Dynasty", bar & lounge ZATTA, Marble Lounge (buffet) and St. George's Bar (Metropolitan Grill, Junisoh, Dynasty and ZATTA are on the 2F dining floor). Private rooms mostly seat 4 to 12, and Chinese cuisine "Dynasty" has private rooms for 15 to 40 (room charge: lunch 20,000 yen / dinner 30,000 yen, tax and service charge included).
